study type: Methodological evaluation using prospective cohort data
exposure: maternal smoking of >10 cigarettes per day
cohort: The study compared an internet-based preconception cohort (Snart Gravid, n=4,801) with the total population of singleton live births in the Danish Medical Birth Registry (n=239,791).
finding: The study found that most perinatal association results were very similar between the internet-based cohort and the total population, suggesting that internet-based recruitment may not be more prone to selection bias than traditional methods.
